fields.value: Project Manager and Certified Scrum Master

Seasoned Project Manager and Certified Scrum Master (6.5 years) with 14+ years of experience driving large-scale banking, lending, and regulatory compliance programs across global financial institutions. Proven expertise in managing end-to-end project delivery — from scope definition and sprint execution to go- live readiness, release governance, and hypercare support, with strong stakeholder communication. Adept at leading Agile–Waterfall hybrid delivery models, integrating Project Tracking Systems (PTS) for milestone tracking, risk mitigation, and audit readiness. Skilled in managing cross-functional, onshore– offshore teams and coordinating with PMOs, vendors, and business stakeholders for seamless delivery. Experienced in digital transformation initiatives focused on mobile banking, digital onboarding, and customer journey modernization, leveraging API-led integration, automation, and data governance frameworks to enhance customer experience and regulatory compliance. Strong exposure to service transition, including BAU handover, documentation, and end-user training to ensure smooth adoption.

fields.value: The KSA RHQ Entity Enablement Project was initiated under a Saudi regulatory directive requiring Citibank to establish a Regional Headquarters legal entity and secure a MISA license. The initiative complied with CBAT (Cross-Border Approval & Transparency) processes and involved enabling and validating critical financial systems — APS, FFS, PERL, GENESIS, P2P, and eRECON — ensuring seamless integration, data integrity, and operational independence of the new entity.

citations.quote: Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Modernization – Modernized procurement and financial workflow for Citi

fields.value: The Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Modernization Project was executed as part of Citi’s global P2P program to expand procurement and finance operations in China. It involved the setup of two new legal entities, Citi Securities and Citi Futures Company, regulatory approvals, and system integration across Fullsuite, PEARL, and S2, including implementation of GL and FA modules. The project adopted a dual-cycle testing strategy — pre– and post–regulatory approval — to ensure compliance, audit readiness, and localization of financial operations.
